newsitem.title: USA: Texaco says pact with EEOC not intrusive.
newsitem.headline: Texaco says pact with EEOC not intrusive.

text.p: A Texaco Inc spokesman on Friday said that the company was satisfied with its agreement with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and that the EEOC's intervention was not viewed as intrusive.
When asked if the commission's access to company data and employees over a five-year period was seen as an intrusion, the spokesman added, "I would in no way catagorize their role as intrusive."
Under the accord, the EEOC will monitor Texaco's compliance with federal law by inspecting the firm's records and staff.

"We are satisfied with the agreement with EEOC and we are comfortable with the schedule presented to Judge Brieant on moving toward final approval of the settlement agreement," a Texaco spokesman said.
"Look at (today's agreement) and the programs (we) announced December 18, and you'll find that there is consistency throughout," he said.
In December, Texaco set plans to boost employment and advancement of minorities, as well as purchasing from minority-owned suppliers.
